_about: Who does what, in failover order. The first machine in a list that is active and checked in is the one serving that role; the next one takes over when it is disconnected or goes quiet. Edit this file to change the order, then re-run install-fleet.ps1 (or copy it to C:\Jarvis\fleet\).

hub.label: Phone app + approvals
hub.note: The laptop only covers this once a standby hub is installed there.

worker.label: Claude Worker (task cards)
worker.note: machine:any cards go to whichever Worker is active; cards pinned to one machine wait for it.
